_note: These are YOUR tasks in the Stripe Dashboard before the backend can be set up. Do these steps and send the three env vars to your backend dev securely (password manager, not plain email).

step_1_create_restricted_api_key.where: Stripe Dashboard → Developers → API Keys → + Create restricted key

step_2_register_webhook_endpoint.where: Stripe Dashboard → Developers → Webhooks → + Add endpoint
step_2_register_webhook_endpoint.after_saving: Click the new webhook entry → Reveal 'Signing secret' → copy the whsec_... value

step_3_price_id.note: This single price ID covers both trial and premium. No second price needed.
